b0.pin: replay of the retained coin series b0

preregistered.estimates: per template and batch kind, the raw selector contrast of each batch (base: the arm contrast P(s=0 | coin read 1) - P(s=0 | coin read 0); twin: P(s=0) of the coin-1 twin minus that of the coin-0 twin), pooled over the replicate batches by inverse variance
preregistered.heterogeneity: replicate batches of one template and kind agree within chi-square 10.828 (1 degree of freedom, alpha 0.001); the three 6-CZ blocks agree within chi-square 9.21 (2 degrees of freedom, alpha 0.01) for the base contrasts and for the twin contrasts; otherwise the decision is unresolved
preregistered.control: b0 base contrast s0 above 3.0 se, else the offset is absent and nothing about its mechanism is decided
preregistered.twin_control: b0 twin contrast t0 above 3.0 se; if not, and s0 - t0 exceeds 3.0 combined se, the offset exists only with the coin in superposition
preregistered.six_cz: c and d the inverse-variance means of the three 6-CZ base and twin contrasts, m their combination and r the combination of s0 and t0: contexts disagree when |c - d| exceeds 3.0 combined se; zero when |m| is within 3.0 se and r - m exceeds 3.0 combined se; b0-like when m exceeds 3.0 se and |r - m| is within 2.0 combined se; intermediate (unresolved) when m exceeds 3.0 se outside that band; otherwise unresolved
preregistered.calibration: the eight X-only preparations of q2, q8 and q12 are a secondary readout calibration in a terminal-assignment context: D, the selector misassignment with the coin prepared 1 minus 0 at a prepared selector 1, and G, with q12 prepared 0 minus 1, are reported with large (>= 0.036 - 3.0 se) and small (|.| + 3.0 se < 0.012) classes and change no outcome
preregistered.qx: every circuit within twice the sampling floor of its ideal law
